page_title: PSG 3-3 HAV | PSG v Le Havre 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+6' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+5' Substitution. Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) replaces Emmanuel Sabbi.

90+4' 3 - 3 The ball hits the back of the net! Kang-In Lee showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets onto the scoresheets by sweetly heading it inside the left post – 3:3.
90+3' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90+2' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) attempts to discuss the decision with Willy Delajod, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Senny Mayulu (PSG) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.

89' Vitinha (PSG) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
88' 12:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
85' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes the corner but it's cleared.

84' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Arthur Desmas is alert and denies him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
82' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replaces Josue Casimir.
82' A substitution has been made. Oussama Targhalline is replaced by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
81' Senny Mayulu (PSG) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
80' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kang-In Lee (PSG).

78' 2 - 3 Superb finishing from Achraf Hakimi (PSG). Goncalo Ramos plays a fantastic through ball and finds Achraf Hakimi (PSG), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 2:3.
78' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
75' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' The ball possession at the moment is 77:23.
71' It will be a substitution. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is ready to enter the pitch as Andre Ayew walks off.
69' The PSG players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Kang-In Lee (PSG) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
66' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
65' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
65' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' PSG take a short corner kick.
62' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani will be replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
62' The substitution has been made. Milan Skriniar (PSG) has replaced Marquinhos.
61' 1 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Keylor Navas no chance!
61' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' It’s a PENALTY to Le Havre after the VAR review!

60' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Willy Delajod interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
59' PENALTY APPEAL by Le Havre, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
58' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is caught offside!
57' Kang-In Lee (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

55' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
54' An attempted cross from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared.
52' Kylian Mbappe almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Kang-In Lee (PSG) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Luis Enrique gives a chance to Senny Mayulu and Bradley Barcola (PSG) is off.
46' The game is over for Ousmane Dembele. Kylian Mbappe (PSG) comes on for the second half.
46' Luis Enrique makes a half-time substitution. Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes on in place of Marco Asensio.
46' The whistle blows and Willy Delajod starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Arthur Desmas comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

42' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
42' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner.
41' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

38' 1 - 2 Goal! Loic Nego finds Andre Ayew (Le Havre) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom right corner. Fantasy football! 1:2.
37' The corner kick from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
37' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.

35' Danilo Pereira (PSG) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul.
34' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
33' The game is interrupted as Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is flagged offside.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from PSG was in an offside position.
32' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

29' 1 - 1 Goal! Warren Zaire-Emery displays great vision and sends a pass to Bradley Barcola (PSG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 1:1.
27' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
26' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
25' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. PSG will take a corner kick.
22' The game is interrupted now, Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Ousmane Dembele (PSG) took the corner.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is teed up on the edge of the box by Emmanuel Sabbi, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
19' PSG are ruled offside.
19' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
17' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

15' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
13' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
12' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
10' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
10' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner which is cleared.
9' Marco Asensio (PSG) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for PSG.
8' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' A lofted cross from Bradley Barcola (PSG) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
4' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
2' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
PSG will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
